note: One cut per role, 17 October 2026: "there must be a differentiation from an agent to a sales support to the branch manager to the unit manager". Every name, hour and figure on screen is made up. The hours are the tracker's own schedule; where the branch's real shifts differ, the Day Blocks tab is what changes, not this file.

scenes.eyebrow: The day, for the branch manager
scenes.headline: It is read before anybody is in
scenes.line: The branch manager's day starts at five. So the read lands at five, before anybody else is in.
scenes.tail: Five o'clock to midnight, and the envelope is the wall's own

scenes.headline: Five figures, and the gap between two
scenes.line: Five figures. What is stuck. What it is worth. What we recommended. What we wrote. And how many closed off their day.
scenes.note: More is stuck in the pipeline than the branch has written all year. Twenty two times more.

scenes.headline: A third of the work waits on somebody unnamed
scenes.line: And one finding no report has ever carried. A third of every open task in this branch reads waiting on someone else. Nothing anywhere records who. So none of it can be chased from this room.
scenes.note: Of 399 open tasks. Until who is recorded, a third of the branch's work cannot be chased by anybody.

scenes.eyebrow: Your day, the same as theirs
scenes.headline: You are on the same list
scenes.line: Your own day is read the same way. Two blocks in of five. The two o'clock message written for you to send. The three o'clock checkpoint. And the same close-out as every desk.
scenes.foot: Every topic for Wednesday is already written, one per person, with its figure under it.

words3: Walk in with the questions already written.
scenes.line: Read it at five. Send the two o'clock. Walk in on Wednesday with the questions already written. Nobody has to be led.
